body: In our US elections, there’s been a lot of mockery of community organizers. But in my travels, I’ve seen the tremendous courage and sacrifice of community organizers. This morning, I read about community organizers in Honduras who have been killed for their work on behalf of justice for the poor. I also was able to advocate for their colleagues so they will not become victims of community oppressors … I hope that you’ll take a few minutes to learn the truth about the important work of these dedicated Christian community organizers, and that you’ll add your voice in their support here …
